title: Golf Club Brush with Water Spray – Portable Cleaning
descriptionHtml:
Clean clubs give better shots

Dirt and grass in the grooves of the club affect both feel and contact. Wiping them off with your hand rarely works well.

Brush and water spray in one

This brush has a built-in water spray that loosens the dirt while you brush. It's small and easy to hang on your golf bag so you always have it close.

Features

  • Built-in water spray
  • Cleans the grooves and the clubhead
  • Small and portable
  • Easy to hang on the golf bag
  • Gives cleaner clubs and better contact

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
